thesis: The page is the takeoff sheet a builder fills in with a carpenter's pencil: Tallyboard counts every joist, board and post in pencil tallies in front of you, and a grade stamp signs off each count before you pay.

signature.name: Tally & Grade Stamp
signature.summary: Two primitives drawn once: a hand-drawn SVG five-bar tally gate (4 graphite strokes + a grade-stamp-blue slash) that always counts something real, and an ink-box lumber grade stamp (mono code + Arvo caps) as every section label. Hero joist-plan tile tallies its 10 joists as the h1 settles; the board counter prints its results as tally strips and keeps a running tally card that becomes the quote prefill; the posts story adds a stroke per post as the fence elevation draws below the frost line; review cards and sample price rows are stamped; the form's step marker is a tally; the footer closes on the page's total tally and a SAMPLE licence stamp.

palette.family: Kiln Pine + Graphite + Grade-Stamp Blue + Lumber-Crayon Yellow

layoutMoves: takeoff-sheet rows with a right margin count column (tallies + mono numbers)
hero mosaic of 1 photo + 3 drawn takeoff tiles
sticky running-tally card beside the counter that becomes the form
services as a bill-of-materials ledger, not cards

motion.intro: h1 line-mask rise 700ms while the hero joist plan draws its joists and the tally strokes draw 1-2-3-4 then the slash at 900ms; skippable, text readable from frame 0.
stories: draw: pinned (>=900px) fence elevation draws post by post via --sw-p, each post adds a tally stroke and drops a depth line below a dashed frost line; stacked cards under 640.
stamp: each section grade stamp thunks in once (scale 1.08 to 1 with a fading 4px ink spread, 260ms).
motion.hover: pencil underline: 2px graphite line grows scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, 200ms.
